theorem_summary.name: semantic_relation_support_certificate
theorem_summary.measured_object: declared support coordinates inside the scope of a nonlinear semantic relation
theorem_summary.relation_scope: finite Boolean relations over formula-label variables
theorem_summary.consequence: support-locality implies that the declared support is a standard membership certificate for each imposed relation instance

sat_self_reduction_example.interpretation: unsatisfiable parent decompositions require fixing parent and both children; satisfiable decompositions can be certified by parent plus one satisfiable child

gate_impact.C7: partially addresses the beyond-equality-constraints literature boundary
gate_impact.C10: turns nonlinear SAT semantics into a local audit obligation rather than a vague open caveat
